"""
Project Title: Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural ODE Transformer for Traffic Forecasting (ai-ml-ds-GTNODETransTraffic2025)
File Name: gtnode_trans_traffic_forecast.py

Short Description:
Implements a continuous-time spatio-temporal traffic forecasting model by combining Neural-ODE GNN encoder (for irregular sampling and network structure) with a Transformer decoder (for multistep prediction). Uses the METR-LA dataset via tfds.
"""

import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds  # type: ignore

# Hyperparameters
NUM_NODES: int = 207
ODE_HIDDEN: int = 64
TRANS_HEADS: int = 4
TRANS_LAYERS: int = 3
MLP_DIM: int = 128
LR: float = 1e-3
BATCH: int = 16
EPOCHS: int = 50
HIST_STEPS: int = 12
PRED_STEPS: int = 12

# Input adjacency matrix (placeholder; in practice use road network)
adj_matrix: tf.Tensor = tf.Variable(tf.eye(NUM_NODES), trainable=False)

class GNNODECell(tf.keras.layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.dense = layers.Dense(ODE_HIDDEN, activation="relu")
    def call(self, t, h):
        neigh = tf.linalg.matmul(adj_matrix, h)
        return self.dense(tf.concat([h, neigh], axis=-1))

def ode_gnn_encode(x_hist: tf.Tensor, times: tf.Tensor) -> tf.Tensor:
    h = tf.zeros((tf.shape(x_hist)[0], NUM_NODES, ODE_HIDDEN))
    cell = GNNODECell()
    for i in range(HIST_STEPS - 1):
        dt = times[:, i+1:i+2] - times[:, i:i+1]
        for _ in range(3):
            h = h + dt[:, :, None] * cell(None, h)
        cur = x_hist[:, i]
        h = tf.concat([h, cur[:, :, None]], axis=-1)
        h = layers.Dense(ODE_HIDDEN, activation="relu")(h)
    return h  # shape: (batch, nodes, hidden)

def build_transformer_decoder(num_nodes: int) -> Model:
    inp = Input((PRED_STEPS, num_nodes, ODE_HIDDEN))
    x = layers.Reshape((PRED_STEPS, num_nodes * ODE_HIDDEN))(inp)
    for _ in range(TRANS_LAYERS):
        x1 = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
        att = layers.MultiHeadAttention(TRANS_HEADS, x1.shape[-1]//TRANS_HEADS)(x1, x1)
        x = x + att
        x2 = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
        mlp = layers.Dense(MLP_DIM, activation="gelu")(x2)
        mlp = layers.Dense(num_nodes * ODE_HIDDEN)(mlp)
        x = x + mlp
    out = layers.Dense(NUM_NODES)(x)
    out = layers.Reshape((PRED_STEPS, NUM_NODES))(out)
    return Model(inp, out)

transformer = build_transformer_decoder(NUM_NODES)
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR)
mse = tf.keras.losses.MeanSquaredError()

# Data loader: METR-LA from tfds
ds = tfds.load("metr_la", split="train")
def prep(sample):
    data = sample["speed"]  # shape [T, N]
    T = tf.shape(data)[0]
    times = tf.linspace(0., 1., T)
    xs, ts, ys = [], [], []
    for i in range(T - HIST_STEPS - PRED_STEPS):
        xs.append(data[i:i+HIST_STEPS])
        ts.append(times[i:i+HIST_STEPS])
        ys.append(data[i+HIST_STEPS:i+HIST_STEPS+PRED_STEPS])
    return (tf.stack(xs), tf.stack(ts)), tf.stack(ys)
ds = ds.map(prep).unbatch().batch(BATCH)

@tf.function
def train_step(x_hist, times, y_true):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        h = ode_gnn_encode(x_hist, times)
        h_tile = tf.tile(tf.expand_dims(h, 1), [1, PRED_STEPS, 1, 1])
        y_pred = transformer(h_tile)
        loss = mse(y_true, y_pred)
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, transformer.trainable_variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, transformer.trainable_variables))
    return loss

for ep in range(1, EPOCHS+1):
    for (x_hist, times), y in ds:
        loss = train_step(x_hist, times, y)
    tf.print("Epoch", ep, "Loss:", loss)

# Example inputs + outputs
sample = next(iter(ds))
(x_hist, times), y_true = sample
h = ode_gnn_encode(x_hist, times)
y_pred = transformer(tf.tile(tf.expand_dims(h,1), [1,PRED_STEPS,1,1]))
print("Example True[0,0]:", y_true[0,0].numpy(), "Pred[0,0]:", y_pred[0,0].numpy())

# Save model
transformer.save("gtnode_transformer_traffic.h5")
